correctness.rationale: The torus monomial parameterization is injective and immersive, so tangent hyperplanes are governed by three displayed quadratic gradient equations. At full-row-rank M these are equivalent to beta=M^T lambda and lambda^T alpha=0. The rank-a augmented matrix locus is irreducible for a>=2 via surjective factorization PQ and irreducible bilinear southeast-zero constraint; generic points satisfy nonzero torus tangencies, giving equality of reduced closed duals. Independent rank/codimension count yields b-a+1; standard maximal-minor Porteous degree binomial(b+1,a) survives a proper hyperplane section; generic torus-contact closure is a linear P^(b-a). Exact supplementary symbolic checks validate representative cases and balanced adjugate identities. General facts do not rely on finite tests.
